description: End a poll the bot created before its duration runs out. Discord does not let a bot end polls posted by other users. Returns the message with the poll; Discord finishes the final vote count in the background, so read the final tally later with discord_get_message once poll.results.is_finalized is true. Bot permissions it may need: View Channel. Changes or removes existing Discord data without an approval prompt.

channel_id.description: ID of the channel or thread that holds the message
